create_td_setup: create Traffic Director setup for gRPC proxyless with a specified flagfile configuration
cleanup_td_resources: cleanup Traffic Director resources and configuration using the cleanup command
setup_mtls_security: setup mutual TLS security for Traffic Director gRPC proxyless configuration
add_backend_services: add backend services and NEG backends to Traffic Director for a server
cycle_td_config: cycle Traffic Director configuration by creating and then cleaning up resources
